newsitem.title: JAPAN: NEC wins 2.2 bln yen Egypt telecoms order.
newsitem.headline: NEC wins 2.2 bln yen Egypt telecoms order.

text.p: NEC Corp said on Wednesday that it had received a 2.2 billion yen order for digital public switching systems and microwave transmission systems to be used in the expansion of telecommunications infrastructure in Egypt.
The order was received through trading house Sumitomo Corp from the Arab Republic of Egypt National Telecommunications Organisation, NEC said in a statement.
NEC signed a cooperative agreement with the organisation in January in order to participate in Egypt's five-year plan to expand its telecommunications infrastructure, NEC said.
